title: Dynamics & Newton's Laws
notes: **Newton's first law:** a body at rest stays at rest and a body in motion stays in uniform motion unless acted on by a net external force. Inertia = the tendency to resist change in state of motion; mass is a measure of inertia.
**Newton's second law:** F = ma — the rate of change of momentum is proportional to the applied force and takes place in the direction of the force.
**Newton's third law:** for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction. Forces always act in pairs on different bodies.
**Impulse** = F·Δt = change in momentum. **Momentum** p = mv.
**Friction:** static, kinetic (sliding) and rolling. F_max = μN where μ is the coefficient of friction, N the normal reaction.
